summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) building real-time robotics software across embedded and ROS2 platforms. Integrated safety-focused sensor interlocks and real-time C++/Python control loops across a distributed voice-controlled robotic arm (COFFIN) and a FreeRTOS-based tracking turret, and validated motion-planning and perception pipelines in ROS2/MoveIt and CARLA simulation. Comfortable designing software abstractions that bridge platform-specific hardware (STM32, Jetson, UR5e, AL5B) behind a common control and communication layer.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and visualization; used GitLab for version control.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system across a three-layer pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller over WebSocket.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing and dual ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via I2C mux; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz in ROS 2.
Planned collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.
